material_params — DRIVE terrain op

• 資料種類:無 → table(僅由參數決定的運算子 —— 不接受影像或資料輸入)

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.material_params(seed: 'int' = 0, grain: 'float' = 0.05, puddle_level: 'float' = 0.55, puddle_freq: 'float' = 0.6, stain_level: 'float' = 0.6, stain_freq: 'float' = 0.9, wear: 'float' = 0.6, wear_freq: 'float' = 2.0, grass_var: 'float' = 0.1, sky=(0.62, 0.75, 0.92)) -> 'dict'(要直接呼叫實作,import driveterrain; driveterrain.material_params(seed: 'int' = 0, grain: 'float' = 0.05, puddle_level: 'float' = 0.55, puddle_freq: 'float' = 0.6, stain_level: 'float' = 0.6, stain_freq: 'float' = 0.9, wear: 'float' = 0.6, wear_freq: 'float' = 2.0, grass_var: 'float' = 0.1, sky=(0.62, 0.75, 0.92)) -> 'dict';從台帳取用則 opsdrive.get("material_params"))

用法

> 該運算子的說明尚無譯文,以下照原文給出。

材質の表。puddle = Perlin(puddle_freq) > puddle_level の所(道の内側だけ、ラベル 11、色 = 写り込み refl·空 + (1−refl)·陰影つきの路面)、

stain = 同様に暗い染み(ラベルは道のまま、真値の場 "stain" に残る)、wear = 白線の摩耗率 clip(wear·(Perlin(wear_freq)·0.5+0.5)·2, 0, 1)。
